findings.description: Potential race condition in plan staging
findings.suggestion: The plan file is staged to $RUNNER_TEMP/plan.md but there's no guarantee it won't be modified between staging and use. While unlikely in GitHub Actions, consider using a temporary filename with mktemp or verify the file hash before use.

findings.description: Inconsistent error handling for plan file
findings.suggestion: The plan file read error is logged but doesn't fail the run. Consider clarifying in the log message whether this is expected behavior or an error condition.

findings.description: Hardcoded timeout values
findings.suggestion: Consider centralizing timeout constants in a separate config file to make them easier to maintain and override.

findings.description: Inconsistent terminology
findings.suggestion: Use consistent terminology - either 'tool-less' or 'toolless' throughout the codebase.

findings.description: Type safety improvement
findings.suggestion: Add 'as const' to IMPL_GRADE_EMOJI for better type safety: const IMPL_GRADE_EMOJI: Record<ImplGrade, string> = { ... } as const;

findings.description: Redundant PLAN_PATH environment variable assignment
findings.suggestion: Remove the redundant echo statement that overwrites PLAN_PATH with the same value

findings.description: Control characters in PLAN_PATH are not defused in error logging, allowing potential log injection
findings.suggestion: Use the existing logSafePath function to defuse control characters: `plan supplied: ${logSafePath(env.PLAN_PATH ?? "(path not given)")} (${String(planText.length)} chars)`

findings.description: Incorrect escaping of '<' characters in plan metadata - replaces '<' with '<\' which is wrong
findings.suggestion: Remove the '<' character replacement as it's unnecessary inside a fenced block. The fence() function already handles closing tag escaping.

findings.description: Control characters in planPath are not fully defused in prompt generation - only newlines and '<' are handled
findings.suggestion: Use logSafePath function to defuse all control characters: `planPath: ${logSafePath(planPath)}`

findings.description: Control characters in planPath are not defused in rendered output - only backticks are escaped by codeSpan
findings.suggestion: Use logSafePath before codeSpan: `codeSpan(logSafePath(block.planPath))`

findings.description: Redundant check - plan is derived from input.plan, so checking both is unnecessary
findings.suggestion: Remove the redundant `input.plan === undefined` check

findings.description: Validation error message could be clearer
findings.suggestion: Change message to 'line number requires a file path' for better clarity

findings.description: Plan staging from Git object with blob-mode check
findings.suggestion: The two-layer defense (mode check + git show) correctly mitigates symlink attacks. Consider adding a comment explaining why both layers are necessary for future maintainers.

findings.description: PLAN_PATH logging uses logSafePath sanitization
findings.suggestion: Verify that logSafePath properly escapes newlines and other control characters. Consider adding a unit test for control character injection.

findings.description: Plan cap set to 80,000 characters based on live evidence
findings.suggestion: Add a comment explaining the 47,217 character reference point to justify the 80k cap. Consider monitoring if this needs adjustment as plans evolve.

findings.description: Schema consistency validation between grades and findings
findings.suggestion: The consistency checks are well-designed. Consider adding a test that verifies a CRITICAL finding with PASS grade fails validation.

findings.description: Deterministic plan resolution avoids model tool ambiguity
findings.suggestion: Good design avoiding the 'declined tool = no plan' problem. Consider documenting this decision in AGENTS.md for future reference.

findings.description: Finding ID assignment and cap enforcement in code
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a comment explaining why findings are sorted by severity before capping to ensure important findings aren't dropped.

findings.description: Empty plan file treated as 'no plan'
findings.suggestion: Good defensive programming. Consider adding a test case for an empty plan file with whitespace only.

findings.description: Live probe with pre-registered success criteria
findings.suggestion: Excellent approach to avoid anchoring bias. Consider documenting the probe results in a dedicated file for future reference.

findings.description: Clear trust boundary documentation in prompts
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a similar untrusted data warning to the finder and judge prompts for consistency.

findings.description: Model choice well-justified
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a reference to the specific evaluation results that informed this choice.

findings.description: Plan resolution regex uses complex character class `[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+` but allows `.` and `-` which could be ambiguous in path contexts. Consider using a more restrictive set like `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` to avoid potential path traversal confusion.
findings.suggestion: Simplify the allowed character set to `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` and validate the full path separately if needed.

findings.description: DEFAULT_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS increased from 120s to 300s based on a single PR's behavior. This 2.5x increase may be excessive for typical PRs and could increase costs.
findings.suggestion: Consider a more conservative default (e.g., 180s) and rely on the per-run override for exceptional cases.

findings.description: Implementation review instructions are very verbose (~500 words). This contributes to token usage for every plan-aware review.
findings.suggestion: Consider condensing the instructions while preserving the critical rules, or move some explanatory text to comments.

findings.description: Comment explains why sonnet-5 is chosen but doesn't mention the cost trade-off explicitly.
findings.suggestion: Add a brief note about the cost consideration: 'sonnet-5 was chosen for capability despite higher cost; this pass is a single call so the cost is bounded'.

findings.description: The IMPL_VERDICT_EMOJI record uses different emoji style (🟢🟡🔴) than the main review (✅❌). While intentional per comment, it creates visual inconsistency.
findings.suggestion: Consider using checkmarks/crosses consistently: APPROVED: ✅, NEEDS_ATTENTION: ⚠️, REJECTED: ❌

findings.description: The consistency checks in `implReviewOutputSchema` are complex and might be hard to maintain. Consider simplifying them or adding more comments to explain each rule.
findings.suggestion: Add inline comments explaining each consistency rule, especially the ones involving verdict and grade relationships.

findings.description: The plan is truncated at `PLAN_CAP_CHARS` (80,000 chars), which might lead to incomplete reviews for large plans. However, this is a necessary trade-off to control costs and context length.
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a warning in the review comment when the plan is truncated, so users are aware that the review might be incomplete.

findings.description: The regex for extracting the plan path from the PR body is complex. Consider simplifying it or adding a comment explaining each part.
findings.suggestion: Add a comment explaining the regex, especially the anchoring and character class restrictions.

findings.description: The `logSafePath` function is used to sanitize the plan path, but it's not defined in this file. Consider moving it to a utility module or documenting its purpose.
findings.suggestion: Move `logSafePath` to a utility module or add a comment explaining its purpose and implementation.

findings.description: Plan resolution regex may allow bypass through path traversal segments
findings.suggestion: Strengthen the regex to explicitly reject '..' sequences anywhere in the path, not just at the start

findings.description: DEFAULT_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS increased from 120s to 300s without clear justification in this diff
findings.suggestion: Add a comment explaining why the judge timeout needed to be increased, or consider if this should be a separate change

findings.description: runImplReviewPass function is quite long (109 lines) and handles multiple concerns
findings.suggestion: Consider extracting telemetry accumulation and error handling into separate helper functions

findings.description: identifyImplFindings mutates the input array before sorting, which could cause issues if the original array is used elsewhere
findings.suggestion: Create a copy before sorting: `[...findings].sort(...)`

findings.description: PLAN_PATH is logged using logError even though it's not an error condition
findings.suggestion: Use a dedicated log method for informational messages, or rename logError to logMessage

findings.description: Comment about plan metadata escaping could be clearer
findings.suggestion: Explain why both newline and tag replacement are needed for security

findings.description: Code span escaping for plan path could be more robust
findings.suggestion: Consider using a dedicated escape function for code spans that handles all edge cases

findings.description: DEFAULT_IMPL_REVIEW_MODEL comment is quite long and could be split
findings.suggestion: Break the comment into multiple lines for better readability

findings.description: Plan path override regex allows `..` segments, relying on post-check for rejection
findings.suggestion: Strengthen the regex to explicitly reject `..` in the path, e.g., replace `[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+` with `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(/[^/.][^/]*)*` to prevent traversal without relying on a separate check.

findings.description: Silent degradation on plan read failure may hide important issues
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a warning or notice in the review comment when the plan file could not be read, to distinguish it from an intentional no-plan PR.

findings.description: `logSafePath` function usage without definition in diff
findings.suggestion: Ensure `logSafePath` is defined elsewhere and properly escapes control characters. If not, implement it to replace control characters with a safe placeholder.

findings.description: Judge timeout increased significantly based on live evidence
findings.suggestion: Document the original timeout shortfall and add monitoring to ensure the new timeout remains appropriate. Consider if the timeout can be dynamically adjusted based on input size.

findings.description: Comment about command execution removal could be clearer
findings.suggestion: Explicitly mention that command execution is removed to prevent RCE in CI, referencing the security implications as described in the plan.

findings.description: Implementation review section could be more concise
findings.suggestion: Consider collapsing the no-plan and failed states into a single line each to reduce comment length, as the details are in review.json.

findings.description: Plan resolution regex could be bypassed with crafted PR body
findings.suggestion: The regex `sed -nE 's#^[[:space:]]*Plan:[[:space:]]+(context/(changes|archive)/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+/plan\.md)[[:space:]]*$#\1#p'` allows `/` in paths but doesn't prevent directory traversal sequences like `../`. While the later check for `*..*` helps, a more restrictive approach would be to use `basename` or validate the path resolves within expected directories after expansion.

findings.description: Plan staging security check is good but has a race condition
findings.suggestion: The `git ls-tree` mode check followed by `git show` prevents symlink attacks, but there's a theoretical race condition between the two commands. Consider using `git show` with `--literal-pathspecs` or capturing both in a single pipeline to eliminate the race window.

findings.description: Plan metadata path could break out of fencing
findings.suggestion: The `planMetadata` function replaces `<` with `<\` but doesn't handle other Markdown control characters like `>`, `|`, or `[` that could break table formatting. Use a more comprehensive sanitization function.

findings.description: Implementation review timeout may be too high
findings.suggestion: 300 seconds for the impl review timeout seems high given it's a single structured call. Consider starting with 120 seconds and adjusting based on real-world data, similar to the original judge timeout.

findings.description: Usage accounting should be documented as security-relevant
findings.suggestion: Add a comment explaining that enabling usage accounting is not just for cost tracking but also prevents the blind spot where un-instrumented runs appear free, which could mask cost anomalies.

findings.description: Plan path sanitization could be stronger
findings.suggestion: The `codeSpan` wrapping prevents some issues but consider explicitly filtering `@` mentions and `#` headings in plan paths to prevent accidental notifications or heading injection.

findings.description: Control character handling comment is misleading
findings.suggestion: The comment says PLAN_PATH is attacker-controlled, but it's actually from the PR body which is user-controlled. Rephrase to be more precise about the threat model.

findings.description: Schema validation comment has a typo
findings.suggestion: Fix typo: 'understating' should be 'understating' in the comment about one-directional validation rules.
